philosophy.title: 社团理念
philosophy.content:
“乒”搏无悔，挥拍逐梦；以球会友，以技强身。

我社秉持“健康第一，快乐为本”的宗旨，致力于为同学们打造一个释放压力、展现自我的活力平台。

在这里，你可以精进技术，从曾经的“菜鸟”一步步成长为球场上的“大神”；你可以收获友谊，找到属于自己的乒乓搭档，共享赛场欢笑；你还可以磨炼心性，学会在逆境中反击，在起伏中成长。让我们一同拿起球拍，在清脆的击球声中，书写属于我们的旋转青春！
philosophy.content_en:
Striving with no regrets, chasing our dreams with every swing; making friends through the game, strengthening ourselves through skill.

We hold to the principle of “health first, fun above all”, and work to build a lively platform where students can let off steam and be themselves.

Here you can sharpen your technique, growing step by step from a “beginner” into a “master” on court; you can make friends and find the doubles partner who suits you, sharing the laughter on court; and you can temper your character, learning to strike back in adversity and to grow through ups and downs. Let us pick up our paddles together and write our own spinning youth to the sound of crisp rallies!

activities.title: 社团活动
activities.content:
【全年性活动】
个人分制度：参加官方认可的比赛，为自己“乒”得高分，展现自我，拥有官方认证的乒乓球球技排名。
友谊赛（可入积分）：随时拉上好友来一场比赛，邀请干部观赛或赛后向管理层报比分得到认证，即可获得个人分。

【社团课活动】
排位赛：官方赛事。
校队联赛：官方赛事，旨在磨砺并保持校队成员的技术与状态。

【每年一届的大赛】
校乒赛团体赛：每年3–4月举办，3–4人一队，展现团队风采。
校乒赛单打赛：每年4–6月举办，所有学生均可报名，展现个人魅力。
activities.content_en:
[Year-round activities]
Individual points system: take part in officially recognised events, score high points for yourself, show what you can do, and earn an officially certified table tennis skill ranking.
Friendly matches (they count towards points): pull a friend into a match at any time; have an officer watch the match, or report the score to the officers afterwards for it to be certified, and you will earn individual points.

[Club period activities]
Ranked matches: official events.
School team league: official events, held to sharpen and keep up the technique and form of school team members.

[The annual flagship events]
School Championship team event: held every year in March–April, 3–4 players to a team, showing off team spirit.
School Championship singles: held every year in April–June, open to every student, showing off individual brilliance.
